top_stories.title: Indian diaspora groups welcome court ruling striking down $100,000 H-1B visa fee - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: A federal court in Massachusetts ruled that the $100,000 fee imposed by the Trump administration on H-1B visas was unlawful because it lacked congressional approval. **Khanderao Kand**, Chief of Policy and Strategy at the **Foundation for India and Indian Diaspora Studies (FIIDS)**, welcomed the decision, stating it restores predictability and fairness to the employment-based immigration system.  **Sanjeev Joshipura**, Executive Director of **Indiaspora**, expressed cautious optimism, noting that the administration could still impose procedural hurdles on H-1B visa holders.

top_stories.title: ED summoned Zepto founders under FEMA ahead of IPO: Here’s what the updated DRHP reveals - The Economic Times
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Zepto**, a quick commerce company, filed an updated Draft Red Herring Prospectus (DRHP) with **SEBI** for a $1 billion initial public offering. The company stated that it provided relevant documents to the **Enforcement Directorate (ED)** in response to summons and assured there would be no further inquiries or investigations.  The IPO will comprise a fresh issue of shares worth Rs 8,010 crore and an offer-for-sale (OFS) of nearly 11.35 crore shares by existing shareholders. Zepto aims to debut on stock markets in July.

top_stories.title: Foreigners who returned after voting in T.N. Assembly election come under the scanner - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Central and State law-enforcement agencies** are collaborating with the **Election Commission of India** to investigate potential voter fraud in the recent Tamil Nadu Assembly elections.  The focus is on foreign nationals of Indian origin who returned to their home countries shortly after voting, with investigators seeking assistance from the **Bureau of Immigration**.

top_stories.title: Last date to buy these 3 Tata Group stocks for dividends worth Rs 89. Do you own any? - The Economic Times
top_stories.rephrased_article: **SEBI**'s T+1 settlement cycle has limited investors' ability to purchase shares for upcoming dividends, as the last trading day before the record date (June 10) is crucial. **Tata Chemicals**, **Tata Elxsi**, and **Tata Investment Corporation** have all announced dividend payouts this year, with varying yields and performance over different timeframes.  However, these companies' share prices have experienced fluctuations in recent months, reflecting market conditions.

top_stories.title: From the Vatican to the White House: The Unlikely Alliance
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Pope Leo XIV**, in his first encyclical, "Magnifica Humanitas," addresses the ethical and social challenges posed by artificial intelligence (AI).  He echoes concerns raised by **Leo XIII** in 1891 regarding the impact of industrialization on labor. The debate over AI's benefits is intensifying with proposals from Senator **Bernie Sanders**, who advocates for an American AI sovereign wealth fund, and OpenAI chief **Sam Altman**, who suggests sharing AI-generated wealth with citizens. President **Donald Trump** has expressed support for similar ideas, though they face opposition from some liberal economists. The debate reflects a broader tension between the potential benefits of AI and concerns about its impact on employment and inequality.

top_stories.title: Bonus issue alert! Brigade Enterprises sets record date for 1:3 bonus share reward - The Economic Times
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Brigade Enterprises** shareholders approved a bonus share issue through e-voting on June 7th, with eligible shareholders receiving one bonus share for every three shares held as of the record date. The company plans to increase its share capital from Rs 250 crore to Rs 400 crore, aiming to boost liquidity and affordability for investors. **Brigade Enterprises** reported a consolidated net profit of Rs 190 crore for Q4 FY 2025-26, down from Rs 249 crore in the previous year. The company also announced a final dividend of Rs 2 per equity share for the financial year 2026.

top_stories.title: Haunted by 2020, Congress flies Madhya Pradesh MLAs to Karnataka before Rajya Sabha vote | Political Pulse News - The Indian Express
top_stories.rephrased_article: To secure a third seat in the June 18 Rajya Sabha election, the **BJP** needs additional votes.  The Congress has relocated nearly all of its 61 MLAs to Karnataka, citing concerns about potential BJP attempts to contact them. The move is seen as a precautionary measure to prevent defections and maintain party unity ahead of the vote.  Congress leaders have denied any discontent among their legislators and insist they are united in supporting their nominee, Meenakshi Natarajan.

top_stories.title: ED summons ex-Kerala CM Pinarayi Vijayan’s daughter T. Veena for questioning in CMRL pay-off case - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **The Enforcement Directorate (ED)** has summoned **T. Veena**, daughter of former Kerala Chief Minister **Pinarayi Vijayan**, and other officials of **Cochin Minerals and Rutile Limited (CMRL)** to appear before investigators on June 12, 2026, in connection with a money-laundering case linked to the CMRL pay-off case.

top_stories.title: Dressing up massacre as military operation does not absolve perpetrator: India on Pakistan at UNSC - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **India**'s Permanent Representative to the UN, Ambassador Harish Parvathaneni, delivered a scathing condemnation of **Pakistan** at the Security Council meeting on the situation in Afghanistan.  He accused **Pakistan** of "trade and transit terrorism" and military airstrikes against Afghan territory that have resulted in civilian casualties, violating international law and the UN Charter.  **India** also rejected **Pakistan**'s labeling of Balochistan-based terror groups as "Fitna al Hindustan," calling it a form of misinformation and disinformation. **India** emphasized its support for Afghan traders and called for condemnation of **Pakistan**'s actions by the global community.
